key_insight: A symmetry-aware template framework can rapidly map how composition-driven distortions in ABO3 perovskites change structure-property relationships beyond the ideal cubic model.
engineering_relevance: This provides a computationally efficient way to screen realistic perovskite structures and better predict which compositions and distortions may improve energy-device performance.
method: Built symmetry-constrained templates to represent low- and high-symmetry phases.
Used unconstrained supercell templates to capture multiple non-equivalent atomic distortion modes.
Systematically tested 15 representative compositions to relate composition, supercell geometry, and distortion patterns.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a systematic study of 15 representative compositions and uses the resulting structural trends to derive a rapid exploration protocol and assess property changes.
watch_item: The workflow is designed for efficient exploration, but accurately capturing complex distortions may still depend on choosing sufficiently large and appropriate supercells.
paper_title: Mapping the influence of symmetry breaking in structure-property relationships of ABO$_3$ perovskites
